subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - `inert` is honoured by its presence on the element or an ancestor element (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18): `Node::is_focussable` also reads false for an inert node through the crate-private `Node::is_inert`, an ancestor walk, so the cached `ElementData::is_focussable` stays per element and no `inert` arm joins the attribute writes, and the Tab walk `focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`, autofocus (`process_added_subtree`) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` skip it; `hit_inner` answers no hit at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it; the accessibility builder's `is_hidden_from_accessibility_tree` reads true for it, so the subtree leaves the tree and the snapshot (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1446; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:279; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:283-296; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:77-363).

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - HTML's focus fixup stands without its events: `DocumentMutator::flush` calls `BaseDocument::clear_focus` where `focus_node_id` resolves to a node reading `is_inert()`, firing no DOM `blur` or `focusout`, so a subtree moved under an inert box is covered too, and `disabled` and `hidden` read as before (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1051-1063), held by `inert_subtree::a_node_made_inert_loses_focus_and_takes_no_key`.

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - Focus keeps `:focus-within` on its ancestors and asks for a frame: `BaseDocument::set_focus_to` returns `false` for a node not in the document, before its `Focussed node` INFO line (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1896-1899), moves `FOCUS_WITHIN` from the old focus's element ancestors to the new focus's, the shared prefix keeping it (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1920-1938), and requests a redraw (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1941-1945); `clear_focus` removes `FOCUS_WITHIN` from the cleared node's element ancestors and requests a redraw (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1876-1880; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1882); a removed focus clears its chain (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1055-1069); `DocumentMutator::add_children_to_parent` carries the state with a moved subtree that holds the focus, or only clears the old chain when the focus left with it (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:775-780; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:788-792; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:851-877). The `FOCUS_WITHIN` writes go through `snapshot_node_and` and mark no changed-set entry, so a focus move still marks exactly the node that lost focus and the node that gained it — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-upstream-sync-visual-lint-and-real-app-readiness/report.md

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text:
- A `select`'s choice is held as its options' `CHECKED` element state, so `:checked` matches the chosen option; an option created with a `selected` attribute is seeded `CHECKED` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:472-478). The rules, in the crate-private `node/select.rs` cited to the WHATWG `select` element: a select's options are its `option` children and its `optgroup` children's, in tree order; an option's label is its non-empty `label` attribute, else its stripped and collapsed text, and its value its `value` attribute when present, else the text; a single-choice select is settled by HTML's selectedness setting algorithm — the last chosen option, else the first option not disabled (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:70-86; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:220-242; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:258-267). The mutator records every select whose children an entry point touches and every select entering the document — a Dioxus static template is deep-cloned, so its options never pass an append —; a `selected` write sets that option chosen and, on a single-choice select, its select's other options not, a `multiple` select's others left alone, a cleared one sets it not chosen, and `flush` settles every recorded select, firing no event (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1041-1044; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1134-1138; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1248-1252; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1273-1295). Dioxus writes a dynamic `selected` again on each re-render, so a controlled app writes `selected` from its `input` event's value or a choice reverts (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-select-by-id/report.md). Form submission sends every chosen option that is not disabled, by its value (packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:276-286).
 The accessibility builder keeps an option whose parent is a `select`, or an `optgroup` under one, although it computes `display: none` — `hidden`, `inert` and `visibility: hidden` still exclude it —, writes its `selected` from its chosen state with no `aria-selected` read, and takes its non-empty `label` attribute as its `label` where it has no `aria-label` (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:164-170; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:184-194; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:280-281; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:283-296). The user-agent stylesheet gives `select` the border, padding and background of `input, textarea` and `display: inline-block`, and shows a single-choice select's chosen option by `select:not([multiple]) > option:checked { display: inline; }` beside `option { display: none; }`, so a single-choice select lays out as a box holding its chosen option (packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:77-78; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:84-86; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:155-159). Its keys and its click are [Scrolling and input]'s.

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - `optgroup`: `is_select_option` holds under a group, `option_disabled` is the one rule `readings` and `form.rs` share, `maybe_record_node`'s `optgroup` arm records its select, and the tree gives a group `Role::Group` named by its non-empty `label`, which stays unpainted (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:131-134; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:175-190; packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:281; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1253-1257).

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - The default sheet lays out `optgroup` and `multiple` rows — `select:not([multiple]) > optgroup:not([hidden]) { display: contents; }`, `select:not([multiple]) > optgroup > option:checked { display: inline; }`, `select[multiple] > option, select[multiple] > optgroup > option { display: block; padding: 0 2px; white-space: nowrap; }` and `select[multiple] > optgroup { display: block; }` — and holds the engine-default chosen-row pair `select[multiple] > option:checked, select[multiple] > optgroup > option:checked { background-color: #c8c8c8; color: #000000; }`, 12.56:1 as `select_interaction` measures it, Chromium's inactive selected pair, hardcoded since the engine holds no tokens (packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:161-188).

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - A hit test skips a node dropped since the last resolve, and the paint tree's walk does the same — an upstream engine change for every document (§Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree).

subject: dec-html-parsing
text: - **[HTML parsing]** HTML parsed with `scripting_enabled: false`, `drop_doctype: true`, `exact_errors: false`, `QuirksMode::NoQuirks` (packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:105-114; packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:145-154); XHTML sniffed from `<?xml`, an XHTML DOCTYPE first line, or a root `<html>` in the XHTML namespace (packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:77-100); doctype tokens ignored (packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:277-284); processing instructions become empty comments (packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:217-219); `HtmlDocument` uses the configured `ua_stylesheets` as given, the default sheet arriving through `DocumentConfig::default()` alone (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:74-93) — upstream #1189, since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship; until then it appended `DEFAULT_CSS` if absent; `<template>` children parse into a detached fragment (packages/blitz-html/src/html_sink.rs:286-290; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:89-90); file input, custom widgets, svg and scrollbar thumb hit-testing are feature-gated (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/mod.rs:4-14; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:353-354; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:1053-1079; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/scrollbar.rs:199-206)

subject: dec-shell-and-windowing
text: - **[Shell and windowing]** Windows are created invisible and shown after AccessKit initialises, to avoid AccessKit panics (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:140-155); View's Drop suspends the renderer first because a GPU surface outliving its window segfaults on Wayland (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:123-132); windows are dropped before exiting the event loop, citing winit issue 4135 (packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:52-60; packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:150-160); default event loop `ControlFlow::Wait` (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:63-64); iOS redraws deferred to about_to_wait, citing winit issue 3406 (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:115-120; packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:179-186); wasm32 resizes debounced by `RESIZE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 100` because `surface.configure` clears the canvas (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:527-528; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:607-619); macOS ignores safe-area insets so content can draw in the titlebar (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:32-41); `BlitzImeEvent` copies winit's IME event "to avoid lower-level Blitz crates depending on winit" (packages/blitz-traits/src/events.rs:744-746); accesskit_xplat forbids neither or both of `async-io` and `tokio` on Unix (packages/accesskit_xplat/src/lib.rs:97-125)

subject: dec-shell-and-windowing
text: - The windowed shell's redraw requests travel through its event loop (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:90; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:93-98; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:104-106; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:193-194), held by the windowed `seven_guis_native` smoke boot, `focus_redraw` and blitz-shell's unit test `a_redraw_request_reaches_the_receiver_and_wakes_the_loop_once`, which states what it cannot read (packages/blitz-shell/src/event.rs:144-171) — an upstream engine change for every document.

subject: dec-painting
text: - **[Painting]** Layers capped at `LAYER_LIMIT = 1024` (packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:6; packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:60-64); non-finite or > f32::MAX transformed boxes culled (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:404-419); gradient layers needing more than 500 tiles not painted, with a FIXME (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/background.rs:589-592); mask isolation uses opacity 1.0 - f32::EPSILON to force an isolated buffer (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/mask.rs:29-35); a uniform solid border with circular corners is one stroke, partly to work around Vello seams (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/border.rs:154-164); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a password input paints masked in every document — blitz-paint's mask over blitz-dom's `layout_as_text_input` (§Standard Contracts → Paint and shell), a direct engine change for every document beside those under [Scrolling and input], ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Движок маскирует», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer); before it the engine laid out and painted a password input's characters like any text input's, confirmed on a frame (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/evidence/controls.md); its merge surface with upstream is `packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs` and `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs`

subject: dec-javascript
text: - **[JavaScript]** External scripts are fetched synchronously because classic scripts execute in document order, blocking parsing (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs:32-38); boa_runtime's TimeoutExtension is replaced by own timers tied to the document event loop (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:88-94); registered extensions: Base64, Encoding, StructuredClone, Microtask, Url (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:97-108); `annex-b` enabled because web content relies on it (packages/blitz-vibey-script/Cargo.toml:25-28); DOM wrappers cached per node preserving `===` identity (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/state.rs:67-72; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/mod.rs:62-104); removed nodes detached, not dropped (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/node.rs:349-352; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element/markup.rs:82-86); all elements share one prototype, tag-specific `instanceof` false (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime/bootstrap/interfaces.js:23-48); DocumentFragments are detached `#document-fragment` elements (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/node.rs:410-417; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:229-242); `window.history` in-memory, no `popstate` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime/bootstrap/window.js:1-39); single frame only (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime/bootstrap.rs:48-52); a checkbox's or radio's `change` comes from the engine, the runtime synthesising none, so a page's script hears one `change` (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:793-799; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:811; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:827-836); with the browser's `javascript` feature external scripts are prefetched through the net provider because `ScriptFetcher` is synchronous (apps/browser/src/document_loader.rs:207-255)

subject: dec-dioxus-integration
text: - **[Dioxus integration]** Document `base_url` defaults to `dioxus://index.html` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:106-110); `DioxusDocument::new` adds no stylesheet of its own: the default user-agent sheet reaches it once, through `DocumentConfig::default()`, and a config that sets `ua_stylesheets` is used as given (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:35-39; packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:74-93) — upstream #1189, since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship; until then `DEFAULT_CSS` was always added; hot reload only under `hot-reload` with `debug_assertions` off wasm32 (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:167-176); navigation history is an in-memory `MemoryHistory` (packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:161-164); JS `eval` delegates to `NoOpDocument` (packages/dioxus-native/src/contexts.rs:19-21); custom content embeds as an `object` whose `data` carries a `CustomWidgetAttr` (examples/custom_widget.rs:73-80)

subject: dec-driver-session
text:
- **[Driver session]** A session crosses processes on a `std`-only Unix-domain socket in an owner-only state directory — no third-party IPC, named-pipe, pid-file or daemonizing crate and no TCP or UDP port (the founder's choice, 2026-10-07, relayed verbatim); the socket carries the session's lifecycle and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, a driver call and its answer — a call takes an element id and typed text in, an answer takes ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), the snapshot's text and the diff out, and no `NodeId` crosses — where until then it carried lifecycle messages only and nothing of the screen: a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label «Сокет несёт команды»; the English wording is the overseer's); Windows has no `std` local socket, so the cross-process lifecycle and a call sent across it return `Unsupported` there in 0.1.0 while a session held in process works on every target (packages/escher-driver/src/lib.rs:14-25). The session library takes the app's boot from its caller and depends on no app: no manifest under `packages/` names an example, and the one edge runs `seven_guis → escher-driver` (packages/escher-driver/Cargo.toml:13-18; examples/seven_guis/Cargo.toml:35).
 The library names one feature, `accessibility` on `dioxus-native-dom`, unconditionally and with no `[features]` table of its own — decided by 2026-10-07-act-by-id, the entry that first reads the snapshot through a session: its executor cannot be built without the snapshot model — so through `seven_guis → escher-driver` both seven_guis binaries, `seven_guis_native` and `escher-session`, compile dioxus-native-dom's accessibility modules and still build no platform adapter: `accesskit_xplat` and `accesskit_winit` are in neither graph and `Cargo.lock` did not change at that chunk (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/evidence/feature-reach.md, on the dev host's target); it depends on five crates — blitz-test-harness, dioxus-native-dom, since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans `tracing` (`{ workspace = true }`, no cargo feature — answered by the operator, 2026-10-07, at that chunk's plan forks; `Cargo.lock` gained one line for it, `"tracing",` in the escher-driver entry, and no package) and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, `serde_json` (`{ workspace = true }`, no feature and no `[features]` table of its own, a reader of MCP requests, of kept checks and of the live answer line a replay compares, writing nothing — the founder, 2026-10-10, «serde_json, только чтение», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label, the English wording is the overseer's; `Cargo.lock` gained one line, `"serde_json",` in the escher-driver entry, and no package — it was already in both graphs through dioxus-html — and no platform adapter entered: packages/escher-driver/Cargo.toml:17; Cargo.toml:165; Cargo.lock:3099) and, since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, `png` (the workspace's, resolved 0.18.1, already in the graph
 — no package entered `Cargo.lock`), the encoder of a shot, its base64 written by hand with no crate taken for it — the key types its `press` needs come through the harness's re-exports `Key`, `Modifiers` and, since the 2026-10-17 upstream sync's keyboard-types 0.8, `NamedKey` — `keyboard_key` maps each of the 11 named keys to `Key::Named(NamedKey::…)`, Space staying `Character(" ")`, and the macOS `ACTION_MODIFIER` reads `Modifiers::META` (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:553; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:589-593; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:595-600) — not a dependency of their own — it opens one `tracing` span per call handed to `Session::run` and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, one `tool_call` span per MCP `tools/call` request, holding `tool` and `ending` only (the founder, 2026-10-10, «Span с tool и ending», relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's), and emits no event (§Standard Contracts → Driver session), installs no subscriber, reads no env var and has no default state location; a hosted session expires — `serve` takes an idle expiry, `IDLE_EXPIRY` (1,800 s) for a host a command line starts, and a host that has answered no request for that long ends exactly as on `stop`, every answered request, a refused or malformed one included, starting the count again (the founder's answer to the orphaned-host question, 2026-10-10, relayed by the overseer; until 2026-10-10-driver-cli a session had no idle expiry); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface a session's calls also cross from an MCP client over the `escher-session mcp` role's stdio — a child of that client, local to the invoking user, holding its session in its own process with no listener
 — the request-id echo (an integer, or a string of at most 128 bytes), a request line of at most 65,536 bytes and a result of at most 1,048,576 bytes its bounds: a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's); since 2026-10-12-self-description the command line's stdout and the `mcp` role's stdio also carry the program's own fixed text, held as `'static` data of the one table — the `help` self-description, a session error's remedy and each tool's description with its result fields — riding those ratified carriers, while text from a page, a call or a screen, a new carrier or a new exit still widens; a changed node's `differs` crosses as a closed set by the rule of 2026-10-10; no dependency added, `serde_json` still a reader only — ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Внутри, с правилом» and «help — десятый глагол», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer; the wrap's card confirmed, «Подтвердить всё», the same channel); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a shot's pixels cross in band on those carriers — its PNG as base64 inside the answer on the session socket and the command line's stdout, and as an MCP `image` block on the `mcp` role's stdio — screen content and no closed value set, with no new carrier, exit or path argument and the 1,048,576-byte bounds unchanged, a bigger image ending `oversize` / `AnswerTooLarge` (the largest whole-screen answer on the stand measured 22,404 bytes, 2.1 % of the bound): a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «В самом ответе», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer; the wrap's card confirmed, «Подтвердить все 16», the same channel);
 a lint's findings cross on those carriers and rest in a kept check as the `lint` verb's answer — stable ids, the closed defect words and numbers, no page text, colour, control value or `NodeId` — with no new carrier, exit, path argument, cause, session error, span field or dependency: a ratified boundary widening; a screen over the snapshot budget crosses them in parts — `snapshot`'s optional `part` (a whole number, 1 to `MAX_PART` = 1000) in, one part's text with the closed counts `part` and `parts` out, a part past the last the empty text, a screen within the budget answering whole as before, over MCP a paged answer its JSON line — with no new verb, carrier, exit, cause, session error, span field or dependency: a ratified boundary widening — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, the `tracing` dependency and the span at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the call on the wire and the idle expiry at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md, the MCP crossing, `serde_json` and the `tool_call` span at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md, the fixed text on the carriers at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md, the in-band shot and `png` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md, the lint's findings on the carriers at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report-gated.md, the paged screen at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-large-screen-in-parts/report.md

subject: dec-driver-session
text: - A session whose launcher names a recording directory keeps its answered calls at rest as one owner-only replayable check — `std` only, no dependency added, unix only like the socket: the calls as they crossed (target ids, a `press` key, an `advance`'s ms, text typed into an unmasked control), a masked or unresolved `type` as one fixed stand-in, each answer as a 64-bit digest and kept whole — its line as the driver wrote it, masked as on every carrier, a shot's without its pixels — so a kept check holds the screens' ids, names, values, snapshot text, diffs and a lint's findings at rest, never logged and never named by a tool call; a kept check replays through `Session::run` alone (`Check::replay`), and the repository's own two scripted stand checks are committed in git, the one exception to owner-only.
